QuestInfo.name: Mission in Kerning City
QuestInfo.0: #p1101002# is trying to give me a new assignment. I wonder what it is...
QuestInfo.1: I received a new assignment from #p1101002#, which is to travel to #b#m103000000##k of Victoria Island and provide support for #bAgent #p1103002##k.

0.0: Have you been training diligently? I have a new assignment for you. I want you to head over to #b#m103000000##k in Victoria Island. Your mission is to go there and contact #bAgent #p1103002##k in Victoria Island, who's gathering up valuable information on Black Mage and his crew.

yes.0: #p1103002# will tell you what comes next. Use the scroll I just gave you to teleport to Kerning City. Remember that you are working for the Empress.

no.0: If you're not ready to handle this, you can always return to Ereve and train from scratch. I do know that, however, will not bring some newfound courage if you never had it in you.

1.0: ...What is this, are you the Knight that's assigned to #m103000000#? You look pretty weak... what can you do? This neighborhood isn't even the best in town.

npc.0: Haven't you gone to #m103000000# yet? Your laziness is quite appalling. Victoria Island itself isn't a huge island in any sense of the word.
npc.1: Have you not gone to #m103000000# yet? There's nothing I can do about your sluggishness... It's not like Victoria Island is endlessly vast.
